# Perception

![Systems Organ Focus: Stage 1 (Sensing) and Stage 2 (Perception & Vision Encoders).](figures/fig_pipeline_locator.pdf){#fig-locator-ch04 width=100%}

::: {.callout-objective}
By the conclusion of this chapter, you will be able to:

1. **Quantify Pre-Inference Ingestion Taxes:** Measure memory bus bandwidth, DMA ring buffer allocation, and cache line invalidation during multi-camera streaming.
2. **Mitigate UMA Bus Contention:** Architect zero-copy ingestion pipelines that prevent sensor writes from starving neural accelerator weight fetches.
3. **Extract 3D Spatial Affordance Tokens:** Deploy Vision Transformer (ViT) and self-supervised encoders (DINOv2) to extract 3D grasp poses and affordances rather than passive text labels.
4. **Evaluate Multi-Modal Sensor Trades:** Build Pareto frontiers balancing camera resolution, frame rate, sensor power, and tail-latency budgets.
5. **Freeze the Observation Contract (`OBS-01`):** Construct the fourth artifact of the Cumulative Design Dossier establishing sensor ingestion QoS and token schemas.
:::

::: {.callout-autopsy}
* **System:** Quadruped Inspection Robot (Dual 4K Stereo Cameras + NPU Policy)
* **Incident:** Robot stumbled over a $15\text{ cm}$ concrete curb; fractured front titanium femur.
* **Telemetry Snapshot:** Vision pipeline upgraded from 720p to 4K at $60\text{ FPS}$. During a rapid turning maneuver, uncompressed camera DMA transfers saturated the Unified Memory Architecture (UMA) LPDDR5 bus at $1.4\text{ GB/s}$.
* **Root Cause:** The memory controller queued camera pixel writes ahead of NPU model weight fetches, inflating VLA policy latency from $22\text{ ms}$ to $135\text{ ms}$.
* **Architectural Flaw:** Failed to budget memory bus bandwidth and interconnect QoS priorities.
:::

| Component | Authority and Substrate | Contract Specification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **What the MPU Proposes (System 2)** | *Untrusted · Stochastic · Linux MPU* | • Spatial affordance tokens: $o_t$<br>• Token extraction latency: $t_{\text{perceive}} \le 15\text{ ms}$<br>• Bounded NPU SRAM allocation |
| **What the MCU Permits (System 1)** | *Trusted · Deterministic · Real-Time MCU* | • Audits PTP hardware timestamp coherence<br>• Direct DMA channel allocation with bus QoS guard<br>• VETO / safe hold if camera frame drops $> 2$ cycles |
| **Failure Escalation** | *MCU Hardware Reflex* | If vision drops, fall back to proprioceptive blind IMU/encoder state estimation and hold position. |

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
**The Sim-to-Real Delta:**
* **What Simulation Assumes:** Perfectly synchronized, noise-free RGB-D depth maps delivered directly to GPU memory pointers with zero transfer latency.
* **What the Bench Measures:** Camera sensors suffer from rolling shutter distortion, motion blur, and lens glare; MIPI-CSI deserializer chips add $8\text{ ms}$ of hardware latency; zero-copy memory pipelines require careful DMA physical address alignment.
:::

## Sensor Transduction Physics and Environmental Failure Modes

Physical sensors do not output ground-truth reality; they output noisy, band-limited signals subject to physical degradation:

| Sensor Modality | Physical Transduction Mechanism | Primary Environmental Failure Modes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RGB-D Camera** | Photons $\to$ CMOS Photodiode wells | Motion blur, optical glare, low lux, lens dust/mud |
| **LiDAR** | Time-of-Flight laser pulse reflection | Specular reflection, airborne dust/rain, dark surfaces |
| **IMU (Accel/Gyro)** | Capacitive micro-cantilever deflection | Integration drift, thermal zero-bias drift, mechanical vibration |
| **Tactile Array** | Piezoresistive / GelSight elastomeric shear | Contact shear saturation, mechanical hysteresis, physical wear |

A robust physical perception architecture pairs complementary modalities—such as combining high-rate IMUs ($1000\text{ Hz}$) with mid-rate vision ($30\text{ Hz}$) and contact encoders—to eliminate single-sensor blind spots.

---

## The Pre-Inference Ingestion Tax and UMA Bus Contention

Latency begins long before neural network inference executes. On embedded System-on-Chips (SoCs) utilizing Unified Memory Architectures (UMA)—where CPU, GPU, and NPU share a single LPDDR5 memory bus:

| Subsystem Traffic | Bandwidth & Access Pattern | Memory Domain Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **MIPI-CSI Video Ingestion** | $1.2\text{ GB/s}$ continuous pixel streaming | Writes directly to LPDDR5 DRAM; evicts CPU/NPU cache lines |
| **NPU Neural Weight Streaming** | Bulk tensor weight bursts ($10\text{--}30\text{ GB/s}$) | Saturates interconnect bandwidth during vision encoder inference |
| **Real-Time CPU Control** | Low bandwidth, high priority ($1000\text{ Hz}$) | Starved during unthrottled video bursts, causing $P_{99}$ latency spikes |


When high-bandwidth video streams saturate the interconnect bus:

1. **L3 Cache Eviction:** Video DMA writes evict hot L3 cache lines used by real-time control threads.
2. **DRAM Contention:** NPU tensor weight fetches collide with camera frame ingestion buffers, causing memory access latency to spike tenfold.
3. **Control Jitter:** CPU real-time threads experience sudden $P_{99}$ latency spikes, directly degrading motor stability.

To prevent bus starvation, systems must implement **zero-copy hardware DMA ring buffers** configured with strict Quality-of-Service (QoS) bus arbitration priorities.

## Spatial Affordance Tokenization vs. Passive Classification

Traditional vision backbones classify semantic labels ("mug", "table"). Physical AI policies require **spatial affordance tokens** that describe physical interaction opportunities:

```text
PASSIVE CLASSIFICATION (Digital ML):
  Image Pixels ──► [ ResNet / ViT ] ──► "Ceramic Coffee Mug (p = 0.94)" (Action Unclear)

SPATIAL AFFORDANCE TOKENIZATION (Physical AI):
  Image Pixels ──► [ Spatial Encoder ] ──► Affordance Tokens:
                                             • Grasp Handle Vector: [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw]
                                             • Center of Mass Offset: [Δx, Δy, Δz]
                                             • Contact Friction Est: μ_est = 0.45
                                             • Clearance Bound: r_safe = 0.08 m
```

### Action Decoders: Discrete Bins vs. Continuous Trajectories
* **Discrete Action Bins (RT-1 / RT-2):** Tokenize continuous coordinates into 256 discrete bins per dimension. Fast token decoding, but exhibits discretization error and high token counts.
* **Continuous Diffusion / Flow Decoders (Diffusion Policy, ACT):** Directly decode continuous spatial-temporal trajectories from latent vision embeddings, preserving high geometric fidelity.

---

## The Multi-Objective Perception Frontier

Selecting a perception operating point requires navigating an inescapable multi-dimensional Pareto frontier:

$$\text{Perception Operating Point} = f(\text{Quality } Q, \text{Latency } L, \text{Memory } M, \text{Energy } E, \text{Bandwidth } B)$$

```text
PERCEPTION PARETO FRONTIER:
  Observation Quality (Q)
       ▲
       │                                     4K @ 60 Hz (Exceeds Bus Budget)
       │                                           ● [UNSTABLE]
       │
       │                   1080p @ 30 Hz
       │                         ● [OPTIMAL BENCHMARK]
       │
       │        720p @ 60 Hz
       │             ● [LOW-LATENCY EMBEDDED]
       │
       │  480p @ 15 Hz
       │       ● [LOW-POWER / SLEEP]
       │
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────► Ingestion Latency / Energy
```

* **High Resolution (4K):** High spatial accuracy, but high latency ($>100\text{ ms}$), high memory bandwidth, and thermal throttling.
* **Balanced Embedded (720p @ 60 Hz):** Sufficient spatial token resolution for 3D grasping with sub-15 ms ingestion latency.

---

## PTP Hardware Timestamping and Observation Contracts

Every sensory observation must carry a hardware-level timestamp synchronized via **Precision Time Protocol (PTP / IEEE 1588)**. Software timestamps taken in user-space introduces unpredictable OS scheduling jitter.

---

## Systems Fallacies and Pitfalls

::: {.callout-warning}
### Common Engineering Fallacies
* **Fallacy 1:** *"Higher camera resolution always improves robotic manipulation accuracy."*  
  *Correction:* Increasing resolution from 1080p to 4K quadruples memory bus traffic and adds 40 ms of image decoding latency, which increases information age $\Delta t$ and expands stopping distance $d_{\text{stop}}$.
* **Fallacy 2:** *"A neural vision model can infer depth reliably from a single 2D monocular image without metric calibration."*  
  *Correction:* Monocular depth suffers from scale ambiguity; small optical distortions result in centimeter-level metric grasp errors.
:::

---

::: {.callout-decision}
### Dossier Delta: Observation Contract (`OBS-01`)
Freeze the sensor acquisition contracts:

1. Sensory modalities, sensor IDs, physical mounting frames, and calibration matrices.
2. Operating resolution, frame rate, and zero-copy DMA memory channel allocations.
3. Microsecond PTP hardware timestamping offsets and maximum allowed ingestion latency.
4. Deterministic fallback behaviors when sensor frames drop or encounter optical glare.

```yaml
# DOSSIER CHECKPOINT: OBS-01
observation_contract:
  system_id: "PHYSICAL-AGENT-01"
  version: "1.0.0"
  sensor_suite:
    camera_primary:
      sensor_id: "CAM_WRIST_RGBD"
      resolution: [640, 480]
      frame_rate_hz: 30.0
      dma_channel: "DMA2_STREAM1"
      ingestion_budget_ms: 8.0
      timestamp_source: "PTP_IEEE1588"
    imu_proprioceptive:
      sensor_id: "IMU_BASE_6DOF"
      sample_rate_hz: 1000.0
      spi_bus: "SPI1_HARD_RT"
      ingestion_budget_ms: 0.2
  affordance_token_schema:
    spatial_latent_dim: 128
    action_decoder_type: "CONTINUOUS_DIFFUSION"
  dropout_fallbacks:
    max_consecutive_dropped_frames: 2
    timeout_action: "TRIGGER_STATE_DRIFT_ALARM"
```
:::
